capture: FMPL south, 16 authored frames, standard resolution (32 pixels per ground tile)
measurement: For each projected physical port center, take a 5 x 5 standard-resolution patch, average the red intensity of the top 30% temporally varying pixels, and calculate Pearson correlation to its expected clockwise pulse. A port with less than 10 display-code levels of peak-to-peak red change is treated as occluded.
index_convention: Zero-based from the positive local X axis: wedge 0 is just above right horizontal, indices increase counterclockwise viewed from the inspection face. The light travels in decreasing index order.

Maximus.occlusion: Foreground fuel-charging station at the lower arc. The material behind that port remains driven.
